phrase: an Indian Sauces and Chutneys Brand
verdict: Yes. Spice Story from Mumbai pitched Indian sauces and chutneys on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Busy cooks want quick, authentic flavours, and chutneys and sauces last long and ship well.
angle: Ready chutneys and sauces save time for busy families. Regional recipes stand out. Quick commerce and supermarkets help reach buyers.
